overview_description: Create, read, update and delete alert responsibilities from the settings area.
intro: Alert responsibility settings manage who is responsible for alerts, from the settings area. They are the same records the Alert responsibilities area serves. Only the listing has been confirmed; a create, update or delete returns `403` without the `MANAGE_ALERT_RESPONSIBILITY` permission. This area has 5 endpoints, and all seven SDKs call every one.
warning: **Only the listing in this area has been confirmed.** The single read and the writes have not been confirmed on these paths; the Alert responsibilities area serves the same records.
notes: **These are the same records as the Alert responsibilities area.** `/settings/alert_responsibilities` and `/alert_responsibility` serve the same alert responsibilities.
**Writes need the `MANAGE_ALERT_RESPONSIBILITY` permission.** Without it, a create, update or delete returns `403`.
**Alert responsibility ids start with `ar_`.** One record comes back under `alert_responsibility`, and `name` is required to create one.
**Listings page by cursor.** Records sit under `data`; pass `pagination.next_cursor` as `cursor` to read the next page, and stop when `pagination.has_more` is `false`.

endpoints.title: List alert responsibilities (settings path)
endpoints.summary: Lists the alert responsibilities from the settings area, one page at a time.
endpoints.description: Returns a page of alert responsibilities under `data`, with cursor `pagination`. Other fields filter as `filter_<field>` for equality or `filter_<field>_<operator>`, such as `filter_created_on_gte`.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: The most records to return on one page.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: The `pagination.next_cursor` of the previous page, to read the page after it.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: A field to sort by. Prefix it with `-` for descending order, such as `-created_on`.

endpoints.title: Create an alert responsibility (settings path)
endpoints.summary: Creates an alert responsibility from the settings area.
endpoints.description: `name` is required. Your API client needs the `MANAGE_ALERT_RESPONSIBILITY` permission.

403.description: Your API client lacks the `MANAGE_ALERT_RESPONSIBILITY` permission.

endpoints.warning: **This call has not been confirmed.** The same record can be handled under `/alert_responsibility`.

endpoints.title: Retrieve an alert responsibility (settings path)
endpoints.summary: Retrieves one alert responsibility from the settings area by its `ar_` id.
endpoints.warning: **This call has not been confirmed.** The same record can be handled under `/alert_responsibility`.

endpoints.title: Delete an alert responsibility (settings path)
endpoints.summary: Deletes an alert responsibility from the settings area. Nothing comes back.
endpoints.description: Returns `204` with no body. Your API client needs the `MANAGE_ALERT_RESPONSIBILITY` permission.

403.description: Your API client lacks the `MANAGE_ALERT_RESPONSIBILITY` permission.

endpoints.warning: **This call has not been confirmed.** The same record can be handled under `/alert_responsibility`.

endpoints.title: Update an alert responsibility (settings path)
endpoints.summary: Changes an alert responsibility's fields or its status from the settings area.
endpoints.description: Send the fields to change. Your API client needs the `MANAGE_ALERT_RESPONSIBILITY` permission.

display_name.description: The name shown for the responsibility.

403.description: Your API client lacks the `MANAGE_ALERT_RESPONSIBILITY` permission.

endpoints.warning: **This call has not been confirmed.** The same record can be handled under `/alert_responsibility`.

url.description: The path this page was read from.

limit.description: The page size applied to this page.

has_more.description: Whether another page follows. Trust this over `next_cursor`, which can still be set on the last page.

next_cursor.description: Pass as `cursor` to read the next page.
